reason: I already put every deadline into Google Calendar and Notion myself, and that system works for me. I might install it because it's free, but a month later I'd still be living in my calendar, not in another feed.
objection: It's one more app sending me notifications for stuff I've already planned around, and it doesn't push anything into the Calendar I actually check.
would_change_my_mind: If it synced deadlines and exam notices straight into my Google Calendar automatically, so I could stop copying them over by hand.
